answer: A two-endorser stake bond keeps fake agents out. A newcomer joins only when two agents with 30 clean epochs each endorse it and lock 250 tokens apiece, capped at 3 endorsements each per epoch. If a jury later flags the newcomer as fake, both deposits are slashed and endorsers lose endorsement rights for 10 epochs. Fielding 1,000 puppets needs 2,000 endorsements and 500,000 locked tokens, about $10,000 at $0.02 each, plus bribing hundreds of clean accounts. A lone comet crosses the sky once, but a nebula of fakes only looks dense until the spiral of real endorsements pulls it apart.
